summary: News Corporation filed a Form 8-K on September 16, 2026, disclosing daily updates under its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program. The exhibits (99.1 and 99.2) contain information furnished to the Australian Securities Exchange on September 15, 2026, regarding repurchases of Class A and Class B common stock. The program authorizes repurchases from time to time on the open market. No specific price, share count, or premium was disclosed in this filing. The board has not issued a new recommendation; this is a routine disclosure of an ongoing capital return initiative. Watch for future 8-Ks and quarterly reports for cumulative repurchase activity and potential program expansion or suspension.
